question: Determine $a$ and $b$ if $$A=\begin{bmatrix}0 & a-1 & 4 \\ -2 & 0 & b \\ -4 & 3 & 0\end{bmatrix}$$ is a skew-symmetric matrix.
explanation:
Skew-symmetry condition
For a skew-symmetric matrix, $a_{ji}=-a_{ij}$.
Comparison of the $(1,2)$ and $(2,1)$ entries
$$-2=-(a-1)$$
Therefore, $a-1=2$, giving $$a=3$$
Comparison of the $(2,3)$ and $(3,2)$ entries
$$3=-b\Rightarrow b=-3$$
The entries $4$ and $-4$ already satisfy the required condition.
Required values
$$a=3,\quad b=-3$$
